exams.subject_km: វិញ្ញាសាទី២៣

questions.label: a
questions.technique: 0/0 at x=2. Factor numerator x^3-8=(x-2)(x^2+2x+4); rationalize the denominator by multiplying by (sqrt(x+2)+2), which turns sqrt(x+2)-2 into (x-2)/(sqrt(x+2)+2). The (x-2) factors cancel, leaving (x^2+2x+4)(sqrt(x+2)+2).

questions.label: b
questions.technique: 0/0 at x=0. Write sin^2x=(1-cos x)(1+cos x) via the Pythagorean identity, so the expression becomes -(1)/(1+cos x); substitute cos 0=1.

questions.label: c
questions.technique: 0/0 at x=0, direct application of the standard sinc limit with k=3: write as 3·3·(sin 3x)/(3x).
